title: Default Space cover is the Frequency dark image, not a photo

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-28: no Frequency photo as the default Space hero

detail: A Space without its own cover showed one of six stock photos as its hero. The placeholder set is now the single dark Frequency image public/images/site/space-cover-default.jpg (ink canvas, the sky/aqua/seaglass pa glow, signal waves), shared by the page hero and the share cards. The Space name in the Hero size now wraps whole words (overflow-wrap break-word, wider basis) instead of splitting mid-word on wide screens.

verify.note: Holds the photo set out of the placeholder and the mid-word wrap rule gone.
